A Different Kind of Birthday: 男孩把生日派对改成帮助流浪者的活动。
Daniel's thirteenth birthday was coming. Every year, his parents made a big party with a large cake, music and many gifts. But this year, Daniel asked for something different.

A week before his birthday, Daniel saw some homeless people near the station. They looked cold and hungry. That night, he could not sleep well. The next morning, he told his parents his plan: no party this year. Instead, he wanted to use the party money to help them.

His parents were surprised but agreed. On his birthday, Daniel and his family bought bread, milk, warm socks and gloves. They also cooked hot soup at home. Then they drove to the station and gave everything away.

One old man held Daniel's hand and said, 'Thank you, young man. This is the best gift today.' Daniel felt warmer than ever. That evening, the family ate a small cake at home. It was not a big party, but Daniel says it was the most meaningful birthday of his life.
